Environmental Commission Meeting
AGENDA

05:30 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Oral comments (maximum of 3 minutes) will be heard from people who submit a WHITE speaker’s slip to the commission secretary. No discussion or action may be taken by the Commission on such non-agenda items. If needed, Oral Communications / Public Comment items will be referred to City Staff either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
